name: Temple Hall
desc1: The hall's lofty roof is supported by graceful soaring archways, and
desc2: the walls are crafted of white marble run through with silver streaks.
desc3: Bright lamps line the walls, illuminating every dark corner here. The
desc4: magnificent temple hall continues to the east here, and to the west
desc5: there is a pair of large open doors, leading into the chapel. To the
desc6: north and south the priestly halls of training await to guide holy
desc7: adventurers on their way to divine communion.
